name: http_post
description: Perform an HTTP POST against a URL inside the authorized lab scope with the given content type and body. Returns status, response headers and up to 8 KiB of the body. Writes state on the target; use only when the task requires it.

content_type.description: Value of the Content-Type header, e.g. application/json or application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

url.description: Absolute URL to post to, including scheme and host.
